requirements.text: Flue runtime and Pi provider path are used in the execution path.
Every remediation run creates a hypothesis ledger and evidence graph.
No patch is applied until OPA authorizes the tool request.
A run does not close while unresolved hypotheses remain.
Data analysis uses SQLGlot, DuckDB, and Presidio gates.
Unsafe SQL, raw PII projection, mutation SQL, and multi-statement SQL are rejected.
OpenTelemetry spans and JSONL audit records are emitted.
Release creation is blocked unless all quality gates pass.
